 Key points
 West Bengal's 7th Pay Commission will also review the pay of regular non-teaching staff at 25 state-aided universities. 
 Staff of the Board of Secondary Education, the Council of Higher Secondary Education and the Board of Madrasah Education are added too. 
 A second order adds 14 development authorities, a skills council and four corporations to the Commission's list. 
 Three bodies taken off the July list are not left out: they are covered by the new orders under other names. 
 Advertisement
 Howrah, 6 November: West Bengal’s 7th Pay Commission will now also look at the pay of regular non-teaching staff at 25 state-aided universities and three school boards. The Finance Department said so in an order dated 5 November.
 A second order the same day added 19 more bodies to the Commission’s list. Fourteen of them are development authorities.
 Universities and school boards
 Resolution No. 4078-F(P 1) asks the Commission to “examine the existing pay structure and conditions of service of the regular employees” of:
 Non-teaching staff of 25 state-aided universities. The list runs from the University of Calcutta, Jadavpur and Presidency to MAKAUT and Aliah University.
 The West Bengal Board of Secondary Education.
 The West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education.
 The West Bengal Board of Madrasah Education.
 Teachers are not included. The Commission’s July terms of reference already leave out staff paid on UGC, AICTE or ICAR pay structures. Only regular employees are covered, so contract and casual staff are not.
 19 more bodies on the list
 Resolution No. 4079-F(P 1) changes the list of organisations attached to the 22 July Resolution that set up the Commission.
 Added to Part A: 14 development authorities and one council. Seven of the authorities are Changrabandha, Mukutmanipur, Furfura Sharif, Tarakeswar, Burdwan, Tarapith Rampurhat and Gazaldoba. The other seven are Midnapore Kharagpur, Jaigaon, Gangasagar Bakkhali, Bakreswar, Patharchapuri, Birsingha and Mohabani. The council is the West Bengal State Council of Technical & Vocational Education & Skill Development.
 Added to Part B: four bodies. Part B lists mostly state corporations and companies. The four are the Minorities’ Development & Finance Corporation, the Waqf Tribunal, the Food Processing & Horticulture Development Corporation and the Tribal Development Co-operative Corporation.
 Three names taken off, but no one left out
 The same order removes three bodies from the July list: the West Bengal Madrasah Education Board, the West Bengal Technical Education Council and the West Bengal Vocational Education Council.
 Their staff are not dropped. The Madrasah board is now named in the other order, with the universities. A state law of 2013 merged the two old councils into one new council. That new council is added in the same order.
 When the report is due
 The July Resolution asked for the report “preferably within a period of 6 (six) months” of its publication. That points to about late January 2027, unless the state gives more time. For the new groups, the latest order asks for advice “as early as possible”. Pay does not change until the state accepts the report and issues new pay rules.
 The Commission’s chairperson is Naveen Prakash, a retired IAS officer. He took over from Atanu Chakraborty on 29 July. Read what the panel is studying for state government employees , or check today’s pay with our West Bengal government salary calculator .
 Source: Finance Department (Audit Branch), Government of West Bengal — Resolutions No. 4078-F(P 1) and No. 4079-F(P 1), 5 November 2026.

 Critical AdSense behaviour: adsbygoogle.push({}) does NOT bind to
 a specific . It says "process the next unbound in DOM
 order." So if you push N times, AdSense binds the first N 
 slots it finds.
 Live investigation (2026-05-29) showed the right sidebar still
 loading late on indianpaycalculator.in. DOM order of :
 1. LEFT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-left)
 2-5. Display banners (4× AdBanner inside page content)
 6. RIGHT sidebar (in aside.ad-sidebar-right, after main slot)
 7. Mobile anchor (StickyAnchorAd at body end)
 Previously this script pushed twice (one per sidebar). Those 2
 pushes bound LEFT + Display#1, NOT LEFT + RIGHT. The other 5
 slots only got bound as AdBanner.client:visible islands hydrated
 on scroll — meaning the right sidebar was bound 6th, after the
 user scrolled past every in-page banner. That's the "right side
 opens very late" complaint.
 Fix: push once per SSR'd ad slot. AdSense binds them all in DOM
 order at body parse end — no React hydration wait, no scroll-to-

 StickyAnchorAd) become no-ops since the AdUnit effect skips when
 data-adsbygoogle-status is already set. --> component was removed 2026-05-29 to eliminate the
